name: Sidecloud.ai Platform
description:
Sidecloud.ai is a managed AI infrastructure platform for enterprise knowledge and agentic workflows.

Its first product, Knowledge Base, transforms document collections into structured, traceable knowledge that AI agents can search and navigate through MCP and APIs.

The platform is designed to expand with additional AI infrastructure services over time, while keeping a consistent focus on privacy, European hosting, data governance and interoperability with external AI agents.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Sidecloud.ai Platform to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Sidecloud.ai Platform to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://workers.sidecloud.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Sidecloud.ai Platform MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sidecloud.ai Platform provides these MCP tools: analyze_document, explain_node, find_path, list_collections, list_documents, and query_knowledge_base.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Sidecloud.ai Platform?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Sidecloud.ai Platform in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Sidecloud.ai Platform MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sidecloud.ai Platform requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Sidecloud.ai Platform is developed by Adónis Enigmático Unipessoal Lda. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
